title: Not Eligible | EU 261 | Denied Boarding
description:
Customer voluntarily gave up their seat in exchange for benefits offered by the airline (e.g., voucher, upgrade on next flight). Voluntary denied boarding is NOT eligible for EU 261 compensation because the customer chose to give up their seat. Validates that DDS distinguishes between voluntary and involuntary denied boarding � only involuntary triggers compensation.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Sophie Laurent), 1 leg AC operated LHR?YYZ. Itinerary: Original flight LHR?YYZ scheduled departure 10:00. Denied boarding type: VOLUNTARY � customer accepted airline's offer of �200 voucher + next flight. Next flight: Departed 14:00, arrived 18:00 (4hr later than original). Booking flag: VOL-DB (voluntary denied boarding).
